records.body:

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Blue Labs
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone. Two Wrenfield emails (email:7e085408, email:2842da6d) with no customer reply ever, no tickets filed, so no signal of engagement. Starter plan, 8 days left. Silent accounts with no first project rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on my last note -- no pressure for a reply. If Blue Labs hasn't gotten started yet, the usual first step is creating a project: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything that's in the way.

Best,
Nadia
